data.name: RD's Adventure Mini Golf
data.detailed_description:
RD's Adventure Mini Golf - Chip & Putt Edition is a game I developed for my Son. It comes packed with 3 x 18 hole courses, with additional courses to be added in future updates! The version you are about to purchase (I hope) or download if your already own the game is a complete redesign of the game, v2.0 was developed from scratch! So when I said a MASSIVE UPDATE I was not kidding hey! I listened to feedback and requests and I am very pleased to present to you all the latest version of my sons game RD's Adventure Mini Golf - Chip & Putt Edition! Check out the features below! With more to come later!

CHIP & PUTT EDITION! - Re-Release Date: Jan 2020



Chip & Putt Edition Features:

  • 3 x 18 Hole themed courses. (Whispering Woods, Toy Land & Nile Mysteries)
  • 54 Crazy holes
  • 4 Playable characters or ball only.
  • 2 Player head to head (Local play)
  • NEW - Ball Physics
  • NEW - Trajectory Calculation
  • NEW - Gamepad Support (XBox Controller)
  • NEW - Steam Achievements
  • NEW - Local Achievements
  • NEW & ENHANCED Visuals, and course layouts for all 3 courses!
  • NEW CHIP & PUTT Gameplay mechanics! Now you can chip the ball to unlock secrets!
  • NEW PLAYER ONE Target Practice & Chip Shot gameplay! Unlock achievements based on your skill!

Be sure to keep an eye out on this space for some exciting news soon!

Thanks for your support! It is appreciated.

reviews.review:
Not having a volume slider's not good but I can live with that.
The game forgetting the resolution you set the game to I can live with as well - it remembers all other settings regarding anisotropic filtering and such.

The issue(s) I have with it is that:
You get no form of an overview of the (lane...is it a golf lane...?) thing, field, whatever it's called, which makes the guesstimation of what to do quite impossible as you don't know what to do/where to go...

The aiming feels a bit like it suffers from mouse acceleration/momentum which may make the character move a tad when you release the button, would prob. have a lot less impact if you lower the sensitivity on your mouse. (if you have one with dedicated drivers/software)

The character aims anywhere before each hit, having it aim straight down the middle of the (thing) would make it faster as it can basically aim straight into the side as it is now...

Maybe it's something for the person reading this, it's not a game for me though, unfortunately...
reviews.developer_response:
Hello, it is a shame that you feel it is not a game you would recommend, as I care about what ppl say and I listen carefully to constructive feedback good or bad.

Now with that said I just wanted to point out that the player points in different directions before each shot as it is designed that way to engage the player to actually aim before taking a shot, I have played many mini golf games that auto aim or aim down the course making the game too easy. The mouse control for aiming is sensitive yes I agree, however again it is designed that way so you can get an accurate shot at your intended goal, so in short aim carefully, Plus you can aim until you get it just right so do not rush to race through the courses, take your time to get it just right.

Also to point out you mentioned you do not know where to go? you can scroll out using the wheel on your mouse to zoom out, then simply rotate the camera to see your intended pin. Just like any real world mini golf course, follow the course walls, anything outside is out of bounds :) Not good hahaha

This is only release version 1.0 and I intend to add to, extend and improve this game as it grows in the community and I value your input as I hold this game close to my heart as I developed it for my son & I and decided to share it with the rest of the gaming community. So thanks very much and I hope at some point in the up coming updates that you will change your mind.

Also when you launch it in Steam did you play the FREE and included FULL GAME Tee Off Madness? When you click play in Steam you can select to play the prototype from Steam's launcher.

Take care and kindest regards - The Dev
